urls.description: Scale delivers proven data, evaluations, and outcomes to AI labs, governments, and the Fortune 500.
urls.title: Scale: Reliable AI Systems for Critical Decisions

data.text:
For all the insights—go download the report for yourself:

https://t.co/KClyo0ckQW

The biggest use cases for AI are in developing entirely new products or services.

Broadly speaking, the pie is getting bigger.

Comparatively, profits remained most elusive amongst all outcomes we measured. https://t.co/Dx1eHLBxNs

While we see @openai in the lead of model adoption, both @AI21Labs and @CohereAI have reasonable share among the folks we interviewed.

Note, many of these results were collected before many new models such as @AnthropicAI's have become available. https://t.co/qGdrvVfewO
Virtually every industry is looking to increase their AI budgets over the next 3 years. https://t.co/1AUlsjeTjA

70% of business folks believe that AI is either critical or highly critical to their business in 3 years.

There is no going back—AI is the future. https://t.co/h0SZTalhnk

Open Source models have, overall, greater adoption than Cloud API models.

With better and better open-source models coming out every month, I expect this trend to certainly continue. https://t.co/UvjqGE0dg7

data.text:
we've surveyed the enterprise and the AI community to see what's happening in AI adoption

if you want to see a VERY pretty website by the incredible @scale_AI team, check out Scale Zeitgeist:

🧵 below for a breakdown of the most interesting insights

https://t.co/KClyo0ckQW

For more of my thoughts on the topic, see:

(Sequel coming soon)

https://t.co/dMQGerP5xG

Last night, I briefed the Select Committee on China (@committeeonccp) about the AI War with China.

We are in a historic moment—our ability to integrate AI into warfighting could define the future of the free world.

Thank you to @chairmang for hosting Mike Brown and me 🇺🇸 https://t.co/4Vo8Q255pI
@cjc OMG ADORABLE AHHHH 💕💕💕💕💕
related, and also great writing via @GuptaRK22: https://t.co/KXrv7NK3kR

the difference between a big company and a small company is that a big company is really good at lying to itself—to sleep better at night

the small company has no choice but to fight for its life

—

corollary—the way a big co stays small is by being brutally honest with itself

it is crazy to the degree to which mindset & attitude is the key indicator for how much impact you’ll have at a startup—WAY more than raw talent.

if you roll up your sleeves, have nothing to prove, & are optimistic even in the face of daunting facts…

you will move mountains
@chrisfralic Thank you! Appreciate that!
@paulg @enf wow this is awesome

awkward truth:

engineering productivity is far more correlated with culture than team size

there are startups w/ 10 engineers that ship more for their customers than big co engineering teams of 1000 (ex: Midjourney)

you cannot throw people and/or money at building great things

Very excited to welcome @goldenkatepark to @scale_AI!

Kate built the one of the most exquisite data engines out there at Tesla Autopilot.

I’m excited to join forces and build the data engine that will fuel all of AI. https://t.co/Ufdy764U76

kinda surreal

but this is very much a team honor for one of the best teams in ai (✨the @scale_AI team✨)

and the incredible innovation of our customers, who inspire us every day

and the journey is nowhere close to over :) here’s to the next leg! https://t.co/lANKhxxy2X

AI for national security will define the future of our world. Either America wins or our authoritarian adversaries do.

Here’s how we win:

https://t.co/TawcO6cWSl

Last week, I met with House Select Committee on the Strategic Competition w/China, alongside execs from Google, Microsoft, and Apple.

I stressed—we cannot afford to fall behind on national security, and that AI is critical to maintaining leadership.

https://t.co/OfohPN4Sze

don’t believe all the hype out there

there are always those throughout history who have foretold the end of the world

the world will change deeply, don’t get me wrong.

just not in a fell swoop of AI subordinating humanity

a superpowerful AI that surpasses all humanity is far fetched based on today’s tech

all of their capabilities and talents have been gifted to them by human-generated data (internet + RLHF)

these models, while insane learners, do not self improve

it is impressive, but not magic

let’s all be honest—working during COVID sucked. a lot.

get your ass back in an office and rediscover what it feels like to love your work, and work with a team you love

not too many other life hacks out there that are this easy
